purpose: Resolve operational ambiguities needed for an honest local R13 development run without mutating the frozen parent protocol or promoting local custody to paper-grade evidence.

selected_execution_scope.reason: Preserve the user-requested frozen eight-process development-calibration scope; do not inspect A and then decide whether to add B.

gradient_accumulation_resolution.interpretation: Fourteen deterministic microbatch backward calls accumulate one logical full-source gradient before one manual SGD parameter step. This selects the hash-bound R10 operational behavior over a single retained 14-row graph.

gradient_norm_and_clipping_resolution.norm: global L2 norm over all finite float32 trainable gradients after all 14 contributions
gradient_norm_and_clipping_resolution.check_time: after gradient accumulation and before any parameter mutation
gradient_norm_and_clipping_resolution.if_raw_norm_at_or_below_threshold: perform exactly one manual SGD step theta := theta - 0.1 * gradient
gradient_norm_and_clipping_resolution.clip_operator_on_passing_path: not required because the gate proves the clip factor is 1

candidate_scoring_resolution.system_prompt: Follow the task specification exactly. Return exactly one listed candidate and no other text.
candidate_scoring_resolution.chat_template: tokenizer.apply_chat_template with a system and user prefix and the candidate as the assistant response
candidate_scoring_resolution.supervised_tokens: assistant candidate tokens plus the common assistant terminator; prefix tokens excluded
candidate_scoring_resolution.candidate_score: sum of causal token log probabilities over supervised tokens
candidate_scoring_resolution.candidate_policy: softmax over the seven candidate scores

model_and_update_resolution.reset: restore the exact initial float32 LoRA snapshot before every source identity and verify the same trainable hash

target_read_resolution.payload_source: internally validated matched-panel manifest, JSONL, raw row bytes, raw prompt bytes, and allowlist receipt

technical_canary.failure_action: repair backend and create a new canary record before freezing the scientific batch manifest

sealed_batch_rules.technical_failure_action: stop the entire manifest and label INVALID_BATCH_NO_SCIENTIFIC_CONCLUSION
new_attempt_requires: documented technical cause fixed without inspecting scientific outcomes
